items.title: Weaving Lesson at a Wooden Loom
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows an older man with glasses and a teenager working together at a complete wooden loom.
items.description: An older weaver and a teenager sit beside a freestanding wooden loom, their hands meeting the strands across its frame. Clear black outlines define their clothes, stools and the full loom without colored accents.

items.title: Serving a Meal at a Buffet Table
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows a woman ladling food from a pot while a man holds a plate beside a cloth-covered table.
items.description: A woman with a braided bun lifts a ladle above a supported pot as a bearded man waits with a plate. Bowls, a cup and the draped buffet table complete the outlined meal-serving scene.

items.title: Adding Portraits to a Family Tree Craft
items.alt: Two children add blank portrait shapes to a tabletop tree, with paper, glue and scissors on the round craft table.
items.description: A branching cardboard tree rises from the center of a round table as two children arrange portrait-shaped pieces on it. Glue, paper and scissors sit around the base, all drawn in neutral black outlines.

items.title: Opening a Book Gift Beside a Rocking Chair
items.alt: A child with cornrow braids opens a book gift in a rocking chair while an older boy with glasses kneels alongside.
items.description: The child lifts a blank book from an open gift box while seated in a wooden rocking chair. A glasses-wearing older boy kneels beside the chair, with discarded ribbon spread across the woven mat beneath them.

items.title: Listening to a Reading Beside a Garden Bench
items.alt: An older man in a cap sits with a cane beside a standing teenager reading from a booklet, in black-and-white line art.
items.description: The seated listener turns toward a teenager holding an open booklet beside the bench. A cane rests near his hand, and a small freestanding pole with a banded cloth completes the outlined scene.

items.title: Carrying Produce Through a Garden Gate
items.alt: Two adults carry a wide vegetable basket through a wooden garden gate surrounded by plants, in black-and-white line art.
items.description: A bearded man and a woman in a headwrap support opposite sides of a wide produce basket. Corn and leafy vegetables rise above its rim as they pass through the open wooden gate among garden plants.
